notes.subject: acrostic
notes.rationale: Psalm 111 is an alphabetic acrostic; verse 9 opens with פ (פדות), lost in translation.

notes.subject: לעולם
notes.rationale: Literally 'toward the concealed/vanishing point'; rendered opa'ãvo ipype (unto endless time).

notes.subject: בריתו
notes.rationale: Rendered iñe'ẽme'ẽ (his pledged word) per discipline; Hebrew is a cut-flesh compact.

notes.subject: ונורא
notes.rationale: 'Causes dread/awe' — versions split between 'reverend', 'awful', 'awesome'; rendered omongyhyjéva (one who makes tremble).

translation: Omondo jeipe'a isãmbyhy'upe, omboja opa'ãvo ipype iñe'ẽme'ẽ; marangatu ha omongyhyjéva héra.
